_comment: Decision D29: which WPT subtests Forge's own tests cover. Forge never runs WPT code; tools/wpt-coverage.py checks this record.
not_yet_recorded: The WPT cases transcribed in Phases 10.1 and 10.2 (tests/web-apis.js, tests/web-events.js) predate this record and are to be added to it.

dom/abort/abort-signal-any-crash.html.not_applicable: A browser crash test that needs a garbage-collection hook (AbortSignal.any() of a dependent whose source was collected). Forge handles the case by skipping a source whose WeakRef is empty (runtime/WebApis.js, AbortSignal.any).

dom/abort/abort-signal-timeout.html.not_applicable: Needs an iframe that is detached; Forge has no frames.

dom/abort/reason-constructor.html.not_applicable: Needs an iframe (a second global); Forge's package compartments map DOMException as an intrinsic instead (PHASE10_DESIGN.md section 2).

dom/abort/crashtests/any-on-abort.html.note: A crash test with no subtests: AbortSignal.any() of an aborted dependent inside a source's abort listener. Covered by the check 'Dependent signals are marked aborted before abort events fire'.

dom/abort/crashtests/timeout-close.html.not_applicable: Needs an iframe, navigation and synchronous XMLHttpRequest; Forge has none of them.
